name: Jung Young-sook
bio: Jung Young-sook was born on 1 April 1947. She is an actress, known for Decision to Leave (2022), The Light in Your Eyes (2019) and Dotdaedo anidalgo (1979).

credits.title: Left Hand Pianist
credits.overview: While pursuing his doctoral studies in the United States, promising pianist Lee Hoon suffers a stroke that paralyzes his right hand. credits.title: Adagio
credits.overview: A man and a woman going through middle age crisis encounter each other in a peaceful seaside village. Despite the different background, classical music becomes an instrument to connect the hearts of these two lonely and hurt souls.

credits.title: Decision to Leave
credits.overview: From a mountain peak in South Korea, a man plummets to his death. Did he jump, or was he pushed? When detective Hae-joon arrives on the scene, he begins to suspect the dead man’s wife Seo-rae. But as he digs deeper into the investigation, he finds himself trapped in a web of deception and desire.

credits.title: An Uncomfortable Relationship
credits.overview: A movie about two daughters-in-law who are on a journey to take their mother-in-law with dementia to a nursing home. (HanCinema)

credits.title: Sinkhole
credits.overview: A working class family move into a new condo purchased after 11 years of hard work. They throw a housewarming party to show his co-workers when overnight a heavy downpour creates an extremely deep sinkhole that engulfs the entire building.

credits.title: Romang
credits.overview: 75-year-old Cho Nam-bong and 71-year-old Lee Mae-ja are a couple suffering with dementia. After being married for 45 years, the couple couldn’t even remember when they were in a good relationship. However, as their memories fade by the day, their dreams and romance that have been forgotten rekindle.

credits.title: Be-Bop-A-Lula
credits.overview: Old age is an inevitable future for every human being. But these four old men are not willing to succumb to time or the younger generations; they are ready to make their own decisions and overcome any obstacle. They try to live the rest of their lives to the fullest and achieve life goals.

credits.title: Loner
credits.overview: A student becomes a recluse in response to her best friend's suicide and locks herself in her room. She believes that someone is in the room with her. Her alarmed family hires a psychologist to intervene.

credits.title: Maundy Thursday
credits.overview: Yu-jeong is suicidal, yet she reluctantly goes to prison for volunteer work. There, she meets a prisoner who is waiting for death penalty. The two quickly fall in love despite their differences, yet they do not have much time.

credits.title: The Spy
credits.overview: A North Korean spy Lee Chul-jin infiltrates the eastern coast of South Korea. His mission is to steal a Super Pig DNA sample which can be used to alleviate the famine in North Korea.

credits.title: Sand Castle
credits.overview: Se-hie decides to break off her affair with Jin-hyun after she meets his wife at a publisher's party. However, Jin-hyun's wife is not going to make things easy on Se-hie once she realizes what has been going on.

credits.title: Three Times Each for Short and Long Ways
credits.overview: Jong Sil, a sound effects director, is awarded a carte blanche for his ingenious invention of a coke bottle opener sound used in a commercial film for an Arab client. credits.title: The Last Tea Cup
credits.overview: Ha-rim dotes on her ailing husband until his abuses become too great. She divorces him despite her undiminished love for him. Ha-rim then tries to start her life over until someone suggests to her the idea that her husband may have driven her away to avoid causing more pain as his health worsens.

credits.title: The World Without a Mother
credits.overview: His mother having died while giving birth to his younger brother, and his father mentally incapacitated due to a serious car accident, 13-year old Yeong-cheol must look after his yoyng siblings. His neighbors, however, feel that it would be a kindness to have the children sent to an orphanage.
